description: Source code for a Lighttpd module implementing simple virtual hosting, handling configuration, path building, and document root resolution.

methods.name: mod_simple_vhost_free
methods.description: Frees resources associated with plugin data.

methods.name: mod_simple_vhost_merge_config_cpv
methods.description: Merges individual configuration values into plugin configuration.

methods.name: mod_simple_vhost_merge_config
methods.description: Merges multiple configuration values into plugin configuration.

methods.name: mod_simple_vhost_patch_config
methods.description: Applies configuration patches based on request and plugin defaults.

methods.name: mod_simple_vhost_set_defaults
methods.description: Sets default configuration values for the plugin.

methods.name: build_doc_root_path
methods.description: Builds the document root path based on server root, host, and document root.

methods.name: build_doc_root
methods.description: Builds and validates the document root directory.

methods.name: mod_simple_vhost_docroot
methods.description: Handles request to determine and set the document root.

methods.name: mod_simple_vhost_plugin_init
methods.description: Initializes the plugin with function pointers and version info.
